title: The Ocean Crown
unlock_policy: Complete a level to unlock the next; progress is shared across all four ships.
star_policy: One star for winning, one for finishing within star_targets.time, one for remaining health ratio >= star_targets.health. Best earned stars per level persist.

biomes.name: Sunlit Shoals
biomes.subtitle: Warm water. Cold steel.
biomes.enemy_behavior: Chasers approach slowly; runners carry treasure and flee.
biomes.environment: Turquoise ocean, sandy islets, palms, coral reefs.
biomes.introduction: Steer, skim past an enemy, and fire a broadside.

biomes.name: Mangrove Maze
biomes.subtitle: The swamp has eyes.
biomes.enemy_behavior: Skirmishers circle while rammers emerge from narrow channels.
biomes.environment: Emerald shallows, dense mangrove islands, wooden wrecks.
biomes.introduction: Keep your broadside toward circling raiders and ride the currents.

biomes.name: Ember Archipelago
biomes.subtitle: Hot shots. Bigger explosions.
biomes.enemy_behavior: Snipers keep distance; explosive mines punish straight approaches.
biomes.environment: Volcanic islands, black sand, warm ember lights, drifting powder kegs.
biomes.introduction: Angle between cannon shots and give glowing powder kegs room.

biomes.name: Frostwake Reach
biomes.subtitle: Cool head. Quick hands.
biomes.enemy_behavior: Fast rammers pressure turns; snipers use iceberg cover.
biomes.environment: Arctic blue water, snow-capped islands, ice floes.
biomes.introduction: Use wide turns around the ice and punish fast ships as they pass.

biomes.name: Tempest Crown
biomes.subtitle: One sea. One pirate king.
biomes.enemy_behavior: Mixed formations use storms and whirlpools to surround the player.
biomes.environment: Midnight purple ocean, storm-lit islands, bright magical whirlpools.
biomes.introduction: Read the whole fleet, escape the whirlpool, and claim the crown.

levels.name: First Broadside
levels.briefing: Sink all 3 ships through open cove and outer headland.
levels.design_note: An open cove and a substantial western headland leave two broadside approaches. Later fleets use the headland's far side, with a clear eastern bypass. The authored route is rotated 0 degrees for this voyage.

levels.name: Coral Courtesy
levels.briefing: Sink all 4 ships through twin-island fork.
levels.design_note: Twin large islands divide a 160-unit central gate from wide outer flanks. A northern keystone island turns the final fleet into a choice of two approaches. The authored route is rotated 90 degrees for this voyage.

levels.name: Two-Sided Trouble
levels.briefing: Sink all 6 ships through central citadel and orbiting flanks.
levels.design_note: One great citadel island forces a genuine orbit: the southern guard, western flank, and northern fleet occupy separate arcs around its shore. The authored route is rotated -90 degrees for this voyage.

levels.name: Gold Rush Bay
levels.briefing: Sink all 6 ships through z-shaped convoy route.
levels.design_note: Two large offset islands bend the convoy route into a Z. The first group holds the southeast bay, the second the western crossing, and the third the northeast exit. The authored route is rotated 45 degrees for this voyage.

levels.name: Round the Palms
levels.briefing: Sink all 7 ships through split atoll and harbor gates.
levels.design_note: Six substantial islets form a broken atoll with broad south and north gates. The player clears the approach, fights inside the harbor, then exits to the last fleet. The authored route is rotated 180 degrees for this voyage.

endless.name: Endless Ocean
endless.seed_policy: Random seed each voyage. Decorate ocean chunks deterministically from the voyage seed.

campaign_contract: Campaign geography and every enemy are authored. The first fleet starts immediately; each following fleet appears only after the current fleet is sunk. Victory requires sinking every listed ship, including boss escorts. Campaign has no random spawning, procedural islands, or timer completion.
